title: Diabetes emergencies in the hospital: DKA, HHS and hypoglycemia
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's diabetes (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/15/2026

Reason for Admission:
The patient is an 89-year-old female admitted for acute hyperglycemia associated with her known history of type 2 diabetes.

Hospital Course:
Upon admission, the patient presented with blood glucose levels exceeding 400 mg/dL. She was stable and did not exhibit signs of severe metabolic derangement. During the hospitalization, she received intravenous fluids and a gradual titration of her insulin regimen to manage the hyperglycemia. Her glucose levels stabilized over several days, and she remained clinically stable throughout her stay. She was educated on dietary management and insulin administration before being deemed safe for discharge.

Discharge Diagnoses:
1. Hyperglycemia
2. Type 2 diabetes

Discharge Medications:
1. Insulin glargine daily
2. Metformin 500mg twice daily
3. Lisinopril 10mg daily

Follow-up:
The patient will follow up with her primary care physician in one week for a routine check of her glucose levels and medication tolerance.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/15/2026
explanations: Type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia only: E11.65 (HCC 38).
